description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🖨️raster plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🖨️raster) from V1 taxonomy shape to the new Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14 in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE.
